persona.description: A man in his early 30s with messy dark brown hair, slight stubble, and an olive green wool knit sweater, seated at a warm terracotta cafe table with soft morning window light.
persona.identity_consistency_method: Shot 1 is text-to-video (invented persona); shot 2 starts on the exact final frame of shot 1.

narrative_mapping: Source: Relatable situational prompt cuts to deadpan cheerful confession of having done nothing. Mapped to: Speaker looks deadpan at the camera admitting he had an enormous to-do list, then reveals with quiet pride that he instead spent the entire morning sitting at Kahve Maya watching steam rise from his cup.

clips.prompt: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 selfie-style video, front-facing camera, slightly low handheld angle. A man in his early 30s with messy dark brown hair, slight stubble, and an olive green wool knit sweater sits at a warm terracotta cafe table with soft morning window light behind him. He looks directly into the camera lens with a calm, deadpan, mildly self-satisfied expression and speaks directly to it, naturally lip-synced: "I was supposed to conquer my entire life today, but instead—" He pauses mid-thought with a steady, unbothered gaze. Soft natural window lighting, authentic skin texture, realistic handheld camera micro-movements, amateur handheld selfie-video quality, not cinematic. Absolutely no on-screen text of any kind anywhere in the shot: no captions, subtitles, burned-in words, letters, numbers, timestamps, watermarks, logos, or UI elements -- and no text, lettering, or graphic prints on clothing, posters, signs, packaging, or any other object in the scene either.

clips.prompt: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 selfie-style video, continuing the same handheld selfie shot seamlessly. A man in his early 30s with messy dark brown hair, slight stubble, and an olive green wool knit sweater remains seated at a warm terracotta cafe table with soft morning window light behind him. A plain unmarked ceramic cup rests nearby. He breaks into a faint, serene half-smirk, glances briefly toward the upper-left corner of the frame, then looks back to the camera and speaks directly to it, naturally lip-synced: "...I sat at Kahve Maya for forty-five minutes just waiting for the steam to clear." He finishes with a gentle, unapologetic shrug and a calm nod. Soft natural window lighting, authentic skin texture, realistic handheld camera micro-movements, amateur handheld selfie-video quality, not cinematic. Absolutely no on-screen text of any kind anywhere in the shot: no captions, subtitles, burned-in words, letters, numbers, timestamps, watermarks, logos, or UI elements -- and no text, lettering, or graphic prints on clothing, posters, signs, packaging, or any other object in the scene either.
